pains: Games that look like AI-generated dashboards: text cards, pill buttons, no art direction
Inconsistent vocabulary for the same resource
Two paths to the same action that behave differently
No feedback (hover, press, motion, sound) when I act
objections: If it looks like a dashboard of cards and pill buttons I will not recommend it to anyone
Desk and map doing the same thing differently
My studio friends will check for craft and for AI-slop signals within a minute; they need to see real art direction and sound
quit_moment: Quit a Suzerain-like indie sim clone after about five minutes when every screen was the same grey card list and buttons gave no feedback.
verbatim: Show me one screen with real art direction and one button that feels good to press, and I will give you the rest of the five minutes.
